pick.name: Google Chrome (personal profile) + Microsoft Edge (company profile)
pick.what: Chrome holds the personal Google account, Claude in Chrome and Gemini in Chrome; Edge holds the M365 work identity
pick.why: Claude in Chrome (included in Max) works only in Google Chrome; Gemini in Chrome launched in India Mar 2026; Edge is the natural home for Entra/M365 SSO and company policy
pick.free_limits: Free browsers; Claude in Chrome on paid Claude plans; Gemini agentic browsing still US-only

alts.name: Brave
alts.why: Best if you want ad-blocking by default for the personal profile; Claude in Chrome is not supported there

alts.name: Zen Browser
alts.what: Firefox-based browser with Arc-style workspaces/vertical tabs
alts.why: Best Arc replacement on Windows (Arc stops working 2026-12-22); loses Chrome-only AI extensions

candidates.name: Chrome + Edge
candidates.verdict: PICK: Claude in Chrome + Gemini in Chrome personal; Edge for M365

candidates.name: Brave
candidates.verdict: Good privacy; no Claude in Chrome

candidates.name: Arc
candidates.verdict: Sunsetting: stops working on Windows 2026-12-22; remove

candidates.name: BrowserOS
candidates.verdict: Open-source agentic Chromium (active 2026-10-28); keep as the agent browser, not the daily driver

decision: Two browsers split by identity is the cleanest separation, especially on a work laptop and puts each AI where it works: Claude in Chrome and Gemini in Chrome need Chrome, and M365 works best in Edge. Flip the personal side to Zen only if you value Arc-style workspaces more than Claude/Gemini browser agents.
details: Claude in Chrome safety: Anthropic says it is 'still risky'; keep it out of the company profile.

verify.note: Arc shutdown confirmed by reporting of the 2026-10-22 announcement: Arc stops working on Windows and macOS on 2026-12-22, new accounts closed 2026-10-22, data deleted within 30 days of deactivation. | Claude in Chrome: Chrome only (not other Chromium, mobile), paid plans. Gemini in Chrome launched in India 2026-03-11 (sidebar, Hindi etc); agentic browsing US-only at launch. Google.Chrome winget ID exists.
